resources.string: Portal: seek bar for what is playing

Holding the Home button opens Portal\'s standby: the clock on black, the screen kept on, without locking. Four presses of the same button leave it; touches, the sticks and the triggers don\'t count. A short press of Home works as always. Portal\'s Notifications button also uses it to pull the notification shade down. Portal reads only the Home button, nothing on the screen.
